newsitem.title: RUSSIA: CIS '96 alumina output slips 2.5 pct to 4.39 mln T.
newsitem.headline: CIS '96 alumina output slips 2.5 pct to 4.39 mln T.

text.p: Alumina output in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) fell 2.5 percent in 1996 to 4.39 million tonnes, an official at Russian aluminium producer group AO Kontsern Alyuminiy said on Tuesday.
The group's deputy director for development and investments, Galina Stelmakova, said alumina output in Russia dropped by 4.7 percent to 2.15 million tonnes in 1996 from 1995 levels.
Kontsern Alyuminiy data put Russia's 1996 primary aluminium production at 2.87 million tonnes, up 2.9 percent from 1995.
Total primary aluminium output in the Commonwealth of Independent States last year was 3.16 million tonnes, including 198,300 tonnes in Tajikistan and 89,900 tonnes in Ukraine.
Russia imports about 70 percent of its alumina supplies.
